title: Pause, budgets, loops, cancel, rewind and fork
purpose: Do to a run what an operator or a reviewer would: pause it and resume it, hit its budgets, let it loop, cancel it and have its outside effects undone, and start new runs from the middle of an old one.

steps.display: agentctl signal s-744896ed pause   # while the tests are running
agentctl status s-744896ed   # it finished its step, then stopped

steps.output: state=needs_attention  step=3  workflow=RUNNING  history_events=52  tokens=545  attention='step or token budget reached'

steps.display: agentctl signal s-ee1446b4 resume --json '{"extend_steps": 50}'   # a person extends the budget

steps.output: state=needs_attention  step=3  workflow=RUNNING  history_events=58  tokens=549  attention='token budget reached'

steps.display: agentctl calls s-7012e3f5   # the gateway refused the call that would have crossed the budget (status 429)
steps.output:

SELECT content FROM context_log WHERE session = s-f037f64f-f3-47a5 AND step = 7   # what the fork wrote after the review

#3  open   agent/s-f037f64f-r3-8890-4

checks.description: a paused run stops between steps and does nothing while paused
checks.because: The pause is a signal, honoured at the start of the next step, so no tool is cut off in the middle.

checks.description: resuming continued from the step it had stopped at
checks.because: It made one model call for each of steps 0 to 6.

checks.description: a run that reaches its step limit stops and asks, it does not carry on
checks.because: Limits are checked before each model call.

checks.description: after a person extended the limit, the run went on
checks.because: Extending is part of the resume signal, so it is in the history.

checks.description: a token budget stops the run before the call that would exceed it
checks.because: The model gateway adds up what the run has used and refuses the next call.

checks.description: the same call three times in a row stops the run
checks.because: The workflow remembers the last three calls and compares them. The repeat was not executed a third time.

checks.description: cancelling closed the pull request and deleted the branch the run had made
checks.because: The ledger shows what the run changed; cancel undoes it newest first.
The record and the world agree.

checks.description: the fork started from step 3 with the files the original had then
checks.because: It copies the context log up to step 3 and starts from that step's workspace snapshot.

checks.description: the fork used the hint it was given
checks.because: The hint was added to the forked run's context, so the next decision read it.

checks.description: original and fork each have their own pull request
checks.because: A fork is a separate run with a separate ledger and its own idempotency keys.

checks.description: rewinding cancelled the original and undid its pull request
checks.because: The original's cancellation ran its compensations.

checks.description: the replacement run is at the review step with its own, new pull request
checks.because: Two open pull requests remain: the fork's and the replacement's.
